# EaseUS

> EaseUS provides comprehensive data recovery, backup, partition management, and file repair solutions across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android platforms.

EaseUS specializes in data recovery and system management utilities for consumers and IT professionals. The company offers both free and professional versions of its flagship Data Recovery Wizard product, along with specialized tools for mobile devices, email systems, and databases.

## Key Topics

- Data Recovery Wizard
- MobiSaver
- Partition Recovery
- File Repair
- Windows data recovery
- Mac data recovery
- iOS data recovery
- Android data recovery
- Email Recovery
- MS SQL Recovery
- Exchange Recovery
- Professional data recovery services
- Free recovery software
- Technician editions
- SSD and RAID recovery

## Core Data Recovery Products

- [EaseUS Data Recovery Software](https://www.easeus.com/data-recovery-software): Main product overview for Data Recovery Wizard across Windows, Mac, iOS, Android.
- [Data Recovery Wizard Professional](https://www.easeus.com/datarecoverywizardpro): Data Recovery Wizard Professional product page for HDD, SSD, RAID recovery.
- [Free Data Recovery Software for Windows](https://www.easeus.com/datarecoverywizard/free-data-recovery-software.htm): Free Data Recovery Wizard for Windows PC with recovery guides.
- [Data Recovery Wizard Technician](https://www.easeus.com/datarecoverywizardpro/drwpro-unlimited.htm): Data Recovery Wizard Technician for service providers and IT professionals.
- [Professional Data Recovery Services](https://www.easeus.com/datarecoverywizardpro/data-recovery-service.html): Professional data recovery services for hard drives, SSDs, RAIDs with 24/7 support.

## Mac Data Recovery

- [Mac Data Recovery Wizard](https://www.easeus.com/mac/mac-data-recovery): Data Recovery Wizard for Mac product page with pricing and features.
- [Free Mac Data Recovery Software](https://www.easeus.com/mac-data-recovery-software/drw-mac-free.htm): Free Data Recovery Wizard for Mac with photo, video, document recovery.
- [Mac Data Recovery Wizard Technician](https://www.easeus.com/mac-data-recovery-software/drw-mac-technician.html): Data Recovery Wizard for Mac Technician edition for service providers.

## Mobile Device Recovery

- [MobiSaver - iPhone Data Recovery](https://www.easeus.com/ios-data-recovery-software): MobiSaver product page for iPhone/iPad data recovery on Windows and Mac.
- [MobiSaver Free for iPhone](https://www.easeus.com/mobile-tool/free-iphone-data-recovery.html): MobiSaver Free for iPhone data recovery including contacts, messages, photos.
- [MobiSaver Pro for iOS](https://www.easeus.com/mobile-tool/iphone-data-recovery-pro.html): MobiSaver Pro for iOS device data recovery including contacts and photos.
- [Android Data Recovery Software](https://www.easeus.com/android-data-recovery-software/android-data-recovery.html): Android Data Recovery for photos, contacts, messages, videos, and music.
- [Free Android Data Recovery](https://www.easeus.com/android-data-recovery-software/free-android-data-recovery.html): Free Android Data Recovery for contacts, messages, photos, and documents.
- [Android Data Recovery App](https://www.easeus.com/android-data-recovery-software/app-version.html): Android Data Recovery app for deleted photos and video recovery.

## Specialized Recovery Tools

- [Partition Recovery](https://www.easeus.com/partition-recovery): Partition Recovery product page supporting FAT, NTFS, HFS+ and Ext volumes.
- [Email Recovery Wizard](https://www.easeus.com/emailrecoverywizard): Email Recovery Wizard for Microsoft Outlook PST file repair and recovery.
- [Exchange Recovery](https://www.easeus.com/data-recovery-software/exchange-recovery.html): Exchange Recovery tool for corrupt EDB database and mailbox restoration.
- [MS SQL Database Recovery](https://www.easeus.com/data-recovery-software/ms-sql-recovery.html): MS SQL Recovery tool for corrupt MDF database repair and table restoration.
- [Fixo File Repair Tool](https://www.easeus.com/repair-tools): EaseUS Fixo file repair tool for video, photo, and document corruption.
